chunks: Al-Hasan b. 'Abdullah b. Sa'id narrated to us... Musa b. Isma'il b. Musa b. Ja'far b. Muhammad b. 'Ali b. al-Husayn b. 'Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrated to us in 250 AH... from his grandfather Ja'far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from 'Ali b. Abi Talib (as),

regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Can the reward for good be other than good?' [55:60] He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say: Surely, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: What can the reward of one who has been blessed with monotheism be other than Paradise?

key_terms.التَّوْحِيد: Tawhid, monotheism — the belief in the absolute oneness of God
key_terms.الْإِحْسَان: Ihsan, goodness — here interpreted as the blessing of faith in God's unity
key_terms.الْجَنَّة: Paradise — the ultimate reward for monotheism

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of monotheism (tawhid) according to the Quran and the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Imam Ali narrates that the Prophet Muhammad explained the Quranic verse 'Can the reward for good be other than good?' (55:60) as a divine statement: the reward of one blessed with monotheism (tawhid) is nothing other than Paradise.
